summary_zh: 本页为绘本《云朵》的封面，展示了美国国家地理儿童版的标志、书名、作者和出版社信息，背景是蓝天白云下的红色岩石地貌。

page_text_ocr_zh:
看, 云朵!
Look up! Clouds!
它们在湖泊、海洋的上空飘浮，在微风中优雅地涌动。
They float in the sky above lakes and seas, gracefully billowing in the breeze.
page_text_en:
Look, clouds!
Look up! Clouds!
They float in the sky above lakes and seas, gracefully billowing in the breeze.
They float in the sky above lakes and seas, gracefully billowing in the breeze.
summary_zh: 本页展示了一幅海滩风景图，蓝天白云下是碧蓝的海水和金色沙滩，文字引导读者观察天空中的云朵，并描述它们在湖泊和海洋上空飘浮、在微风中优雅涌动的景象。

page_text_ocr_zh:
云朵点缀着乡间小路和城市大道的天空。
Clouds dapple the skies above country lanes and city streets.
它们萦绕在高高的山顶，有时高，有时低。
They drift over and under high mountain peaks.
page_text_en:
Clouds dot the skies above country lanes and city streets.
Clouds dapple the skies above country lanes and city streets.
They drift over and under high mountain peaks.
They drift over and under high mountain peaks.
summary_zh: 本页通过城市和山地的图片，展示了云朵在乡间小路、城市街道以及高山之上的景象，说明云朵无处不在，随风飘动。

page_text_ocr_zh:
我们什么时候能看到云呢？几乎每天都能。早上能看到，下午也能看到。
When can you see clouds? Almost every day. You can see them in the morning and in the afternoon.
日出日落时，你会看到散发着金粉色、玫瑰色、紫色、橘色或蓝色光芒的云朵。
You can see them at sunrise and sunset, glowing golden pink or rosy red, purple, orange, or blue.
page_text_en:
When can you see clouds? Almost every day. You can see them in the morning and in the afternoon.
You can see them at sunrise and sunset, glowing golden pink or rosy red, purple, orange, or blue.
summary_zh: 本页通过金门大桥的日落景象和圆形插图，说明云朵几乎每天都能在早晨和下午看到，并在日出日落时呈现出金粉、玫瑰、紫、橘、蓝等多种色彩。

page_text_ocr_zh:
来捉迷藏吧！
Peekaboo!
晚上也能看到云哦！它们会和月亮、星星玩捉迷藏。
You can even see clouds at night, playing hide-and-seek with the moon and stars.
page_text_en:
Peekaboo!
You can even see clouds at night, playing hide-and-seek with the moon and stars.
summary_zh: 本页展示夜晚的云朵景象，说明云朵在夜晚也能被看到，会和月亮、星星玩捉迷藏，并配以城市夜景和月夜山景的图片。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这是冰晶。它们摸起来会是什么感觉呢？
云朵小百科
Cloud Collection
云是由什么组成的呢？原来是水！空中无数颗很小很小的水滴或冰晶，飘着飘着聚到了一起，就形成了云。
What are clouds made of? Water! They are made of millions of very tiny water droplets or bits of frozen water, called ice crystals, that float together in the sky.
飞机飞过时会拖出一条或数条白白的、长长的痕迹。这也是云的一种，叫航迹云。
雨滴是由很多更小的小水滴组成的。你尝过雨滴吗？
云有大有小，还有很多形状。看，这里就有三种云。
Clouds come in many different sizes and shapes. Here are the three main kinds.
卷云
看起来像白色的羽毛。
1
层云

2
积云

3
page_text_en:
These are ice crystals. What would they feel like if you touched them?
Cloud Collection
What are clouds made of? Water! They are made of millions of very tiny water droplets or bits of frozen water, called ice crystals, that float together in the sky.
When airplanes fly overhead, they leave behind one or more long, white trails. This is also a type of cloud, called contrails.
Raindrops are made of many even smaller water droplets. Have you ever tasted a raindrop?
Clouds come in many different sizes and shapes. Here are the three main kinds.
Cirrus clouds
Look like white feathers.
1
Stratus clouds
Look like gray blankets spread across the sky.
2
Cumulus clouds
Look like fluffy cotton balls.
3
summary_zh: 本页介绍了云朵的组成成分，并展示了三种主要云的类型：卷云、层云和积云，同时通过插图和文字说明了它们的外观特征。

page_text_ocr_zh:
滴答！
滴答！下雨啦！
Drip, drop!
云会带来植物和动物赖以生存的雨水。
不管是花儿还是青蛙，树木还是老虎，都需要雨水才能活下去。
Clouds bring the rain that all plants and animals need to live. Flowers and frogs, trees and tigers all need rain.
云中的小水滴相互碰撞，就会融合为大水滴。当它们重到没法飘在空中时，就会落下来，形成雨滴。
Rain happens when the water droplets in a cloud bump into each other and stick together. When they become too heavy to float in the sky, they fall down to earth as raindrops.
page_text_en:
Drip!
Drip! It's raining!
Drip, drop!
Clouds bring the rain that all plants and animals need to live. Flowers and frogs, trees and tigers all need rain.
Rain happens when the water droplets in a cloud bump into each other and stick together. When they become too heavy to float in the sky, they fall down to earth as raindrops.
summary_zh: 本页解释了云如何形成雨水，说明雨对植物和动物生存的重要性，并通过插图展示了雨滴落下和青蛙在雨中的场景。

page_text_ocr_zh:
天气够冷的话，
云还会带来雪呢！
When it's cold enough,
clouds can bring snow!
雪原本是云中的冰晶。当
冰晶从天空中落下时，它们会粘在
一起，就形成了雪花。
Snow starts out as ice crystals in a
cloud. As the crystals fall through
the sky, they stick together and
make snowflakes.
page_text_en:
When it's cold enough,
clouds can bring snow!
Snow starts out as ice crystals in a
cloud. As the crystals fall through
the sky, they stick together and
make snowflakes.
summary_zh: 本页解释了雪的形成过程，说明当天气足够冷时，云中的冰晶会粘在一起形成雪花，并配以雪中老虎和海鹦的图片。

page_text_ocr_zh:
噼啪! 哗啦! 轰隆!
Flash, crash, boom!
有一种云在空中叠得高高的，看起来就像一座巨大的城堡。这种云会制造出暴风雨、闪电和轰隆隆的雷声。
One kind of cloud piles up high in the sky, towering like a giant castle. These clouds create storms with pouring rain, wild winds, lightning, and thunder.
这种云叫作积雨云，又叫作雷雨云。
These are cumulonimbus clouds, also called thunderheads.
跟我读一读：积雨云（jī yǔ yún）。
page_text_en:
Flash, crash, boom!
One kind of cloud piles up high in the sky, towering like a giant castle. These clouds create storms with pouring rain, wild winds, lightning, and thunder.
These are cumulonimbus clouds, also called thunderheads.
Read along: Cumulonimbus clouds (jī yǔ yún).
summary_zh: 本页介绍了积雨云（雷雨云），描述其高耸如城堡的形态，并说明它会带来暴风雨、闪电和雷声，配图展示了雷电交加的夜空和撑伞的孩子。

page_text_ocr_zh:
如果你是一只老鹰，当你飞过云层后，会发现羽毛变得湿漉漉的。
If you were an eagle, you could fly through a cloud and feel wetness on your feathers.
不过，也不一定非要飞上天才能感受到云。有一种云，我们人类可以走着穿过它，那就是雾。雾悬浮在靠近陆地和水面的地方。
But you don't have to fly to feel a cloud. You can walk through one kind. It's called fog. Fog hangs low over land or water.
page_text_en:
If you were an eagle, you could fly through a cloud and feel wetness on your feathers.
But you don't have to fly to feel a cloud. You can walk through one kind. It's called fog. Fog hangs low over land or water.
summary_zh: 本页通过老鹰飞过云层和人类行走于雾中的对比，解释了云和雾的相似性，并说明雾是靠近地面的云，配图展示了伦敦雾景和飞翔的老鹰。

page_text_en:
Cool Clouds
Whether you're on the ground looking up at clouds, or in an airplane looking down at them, clouds are fascinating to watch. Here are some mysterious-looking clouds from around the world.
This kind of cloud looks like foam and sometimes appears after thunderstorms.
This cloud, shaped like small saucers, often appears near mountain tops.
Why can't you see the mountain top?
What colors do you see in this cloud?
There's a rainbow patch in this cloud.
Can you find it?
At night, when moonlight passes through clouds, a small halo appears around the moon. This phenomenon is called a moon halo.
This cloud looks like a long roll and can only be seen in Australia.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了几种形态奇特、来自世界各地的神秘云朵，包括雷暴后出现的泡沫状云、山顶附近的碟状云、带有彩虹的云、月晕现象以及澳大利亚特有的长卷云，并通过插图和文字引导读者观察和思考。

page_text_ocr_zh:
风很大的时候，天空中的云会一边迅速地扫过天空，一边改变形状。
When high winds blow, clouds sweep swiftly through the sky, changing shape as they go.
没什么风的时候，云好像一动也不动。可如果你一直盯着它看，就会发现它的形状在变化。云总是在不停地移动和变化。
Other times, clouds seem as still as statues. But if you keep looking, you'll see them change shape. Clouds are always moving and changing.
page_text_en:
When the wind is strong, clouds in the sky sweep swiftly across the sky while changing shape.
When high winds blow, clouds sweep swiftly through the sky, changing shape as they go.
When there's little wind, clouds seem to be completely still. But if you keep watching them, you'll notice their shapes changing. Clouds are always moving and changing.
Other times, clouds seem as still as statues. But if you keep looking, you'll see them change shape. Clouds are always moving and changing.
summary_zh: 本页通过对比强风和无风时云的变化，说明云始终在移动和变形，并配以孩子们放风筝和摩天轮背景的插图，展示云在不同风力下的动态特征。

page_text_ocr_zh:
如果你可以从太空中看地球，就能看到地球上空总是飘浮着一片片云。
If you could look at Earth from space, you would see that there are always clouds floating somewhere over our planet.
白天，云朵阻挡住部分阳光，让地球保持凉爽；到了晚上，它就像一条毛毯一样，为地球保暖。
During the day, clouds block the sun's heat, helping Earth stay cool. At night, clouds act like a blanket, helping Earth stay warm.
page_text_en:
If you could look at Earth from space, you would see that there are always clouds floating somewhere over our planet.
During the day, clouds block the sun's heat, helping Earth stay cool. At night, clouds act like a blanket, helping Earth stay warm.
summary_zh: 本页通过太空视角和地面夜景对比，说明云层在白天遮挡阳光使地球凉爽，在夜晚像毛毯一样为地球保暖的作用。

page_text_en:

Clouds bring us the rain we need to live. They fill the sky above us with beauty. How boring the sky would be without them!
summary_zh: 本页以美丽的湖光山色为背景，表达了对云朵的感谢，强调云带来雨水并美化天空的重要性。

page_text_en:
Let's go watch the clouds!
Be a Cloud Watcher!
Anyone can be a cloud-watcher. All you have to do is look up!
Find a comfortable place to lie down and look up at the sky.
Be patient! Take some time to look closely.
Look for big clouds, small clouds, fat clouds, thin clouds...
Pay attention to how fast or slow the clouds are moving.
Remember, never look directly at the sun, or your eyes will get hurt!
Can you draw the clouds you see?
What Do You See?
If you watch clouds closely, you can see all kinds of things in them. What shapes do you see in these cloud pictures?
summary_zh: 本页鼓励读者成为观云者，提供观云建议（如找舒适位置、耐心观察、注意云的形态和移动速度），并提醒不要直视太阳，同时通过多张云朵图片引导读者观察和想象云的形状。
